basic_info.description: This Oceanview condo features a thoughtfully designed floor plan with 2 bedrooms, 2 full baths and a spacious patio with sliding doors leading to the 200+ sq ft patio space. The layout is to make it a comfortable home. It is also good to have the in-unit laundry and 1 deeded gated garage parking space.  The residents at the Oceanview Village benefit from the on-site HOA office and elevator- accessible buildings. There is a popular & convenient location where HMart, Chase Bank, restaurants... are in the mall.  Plus, it's just a few minutes walk to the Daly City BART Station which offers quick connections to SF Downtown, SFO and East Bay.  Easy access to Highway 280, 19th Ave, SFSU, Stonestown, Serramonte and Westlake.  This charming home is move-in ready and offering the best value in town!
